response.content:
Looking at this code carefully:

1. **`hit_rate()` (line 43)**: When no `get` calls have been made, `total` is 0, causing `ZeroDivisionError`.

2. **`cached` decorator (line 59)**: Uses `None` as a miss sentinel. If the wrapped function returns `None`, it will be re-executed on every call, defeating the cache. The `get` call conflates "key not in cache" with "value is None".

3. **`get` method (line 19)**: Accessing `self.data[key]` for a hit does not call `move_to_end`, so the LRU ordering is not updated on reads. Frequently accessed items can be evicted prematurely.

ISSUE: line 43 | hit_rate() divides by zero when no get() calls have been made (hits + misses == 0)
ISSUE: line 59 | cached decorator uses None as a cache-miss sentinel, so functions returning None are never actually cached and re-execute on every call
ISSUE: line 19 | get() does not call move_to_end() on cache hits, so the LRU eviction order is not updated on reads and frequently accessed items can be evicted prematurely
